title: Artifact
description: Shared content-addressed Artifact wire object with sensitivity, retention, & redaction metadata. Reused by execution contracts, worker capsules, operation results, & Legion results.

artifactKind.description: Domain kind of the artifact content, e.g. 'patch', 'exact-code', 'schema', 'fixture', 'test', 'report', 'log', 'evidence'. Not a closed enum in source docs — free string by design (judgment call, see FREEZE.md J-11).

path.description: Repository-relative path when the artifact materializes as a file; null for non-file artifacts.

immutable.description: Content digest for immutable artifact identity.

denominatorDigest.description: Present when the artifact is bound to an Oracle denominator (target/control/provider set), matching the legion artifact-record-v1 'denominatorDigest' field intent.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity & retention metadata for this artifact.
